think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/infinite). 3) If such sentinel values exist and break the natural numeric ordering semantics, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). 4) Otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob whose effect changes monotonically/gradually with the value.
